risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (344.64), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinationals, and CPI event just passed; earnings in 26 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (RSI rising, Stoch bullish cross, Hull flip) combined with extreme fear sentiment (34/100) creates a contrarian buy setup near support (30.64) with limited downside risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising USD), price below all key moving averages (50/200 EMA), lack of ADX directional confirmation, absent volume support (OBV negative), and high earnings risk in 26 days make this a low-probability swing entry despite short-term momentum.
